svg.title: Pathway network: ethylene glycol degradation

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:LACTALDREDUCT-CPLX — catalyzes → RHEA:27631; subject experimental construct: 1983 E15-derived selected G1/G3/EG3 crude extracts; EG3 selected from G3. Historical proteins were not sequenced as current MG1655 accessions. EG oxidation: 250 mM EG, 0.33 mM NAD, 100 mM glycine pH 9.5, 25 C.; Evidence PMID:6336729: The study assayed EG oxidation in extracts of selected E15 derivatives, with 250 mM EG and NAD at alkaline pH. The selected strain history is distinct from the current reference strain. (PDF pp. 134-136, Materials and Methods and Table 1); Selected EG3 extracts oxidized EG with NAD. Constitutive oxidoreductase levels increased across G1/G3/EG3; the pathway selection did not identify a sequenced causal allele.; Evidence: PMID:6336729

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:ALD-CPLX — catalyzes → RHEA:20002; subject experimental construct: 1983 E15-derived G1/G3/EG3 crude extracts: AldA assay 1 mM glycolaldehyde, 2.5 mM NAD, glycine pH 9.5, 25 C. Product chromatography separately used 3.5 mM glycolaldehyde and 5 mM NAD, 30 min at 37 C. Historical preparation is distinct from current MG1655.; Evidence PMID:6336729: The primary methods distinguish the spectrophotometric aldehyde-dehydrogenase assay from the separate glycolate product-identification incubation. (PDF pp. 134-137, Enzyme assays and product-identification experiment); Historical extract assays oxidized glycolaldehyde with NAD; paper chromatography identified glycolate after incubation. This directly supports the second event without assigning a sequenced genotype to E15 derivatives.; Evidence: PMID:6336729

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:ALD-CPLX — catalyzes → RHEA:20002; subject experimental construct: 2006 N-terminal His6 AldA expressed in E. coli BL21 and purified by Ni-chelate chromatography; vector construction refers to earlier work. Phosphate 100 mM pH 7.5, NaCl 100 mM, beta-mercaptoethanol 20 mM, NAD 2 mM; substrate specified per assay.; Evidence PMID:16731973: Methods describe BL21 expression of an N-terminal His-tagged recombinant AldA and nickel-chelate purification; the construct differs from the reference untagged protein. (XPath /html/body/div[2]/div[2]/div/div[1]/div/div[2]/main/article/section[2]/section/section[4]/section[1]/p); Direct glycolaldehyde kinetics in the 2006 His6 preparation: Table 1 Km 0.14 mM and kcat 1100 min-1. These are not pooled with 1983 pH 9.5 extract values or 2019 Tris/Mg/37 C values.; Evidence: PMID:16731973, PMID:16731973

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:ALD-CPLX — catalyzes → RHEA:20002; subject experimental construct: 2019 MG1655 aldA DNA cloned in pET28a/pVT-ALDA, produced in BL21(DE3) as N-terminal His-tagged protein and purified on cobalt resin; 1 mM IPTG, 16 C. Assay: 5 mM glycolaldehyde, 3 mM NAD, Tris pH 7.5, 10 mM MgCl2, 37 C.; Evidence PMID:31850327: The aldA gene was amplified from MG1655 genomic DNA for the engineered expression constructs. (XPath /article/body/sec[2]/sec[2]/p[2]); Evidence PMID:31850327: Methods describe pET28a expression in BL21(DE3), 1 mM IPTG at 16 C and cobalt-resin purification of His-tagged protein. (XPath /article/body/sec[2]/sec[5]/p[1]); Evidence PMID:31850327: Table 4 explicitly describes purified proteins carrying an N-terminal His tag. (XPath /article/body/sec[3]/sec[2]/table-wrap/caption/p); Independent direct glycolaldehyde oxidation assay. Table 4 reports Km 0.21 mM, Vmax 1.66 micromol/min/mg and kcat 52 s-1; its Vmax/kcat unit conversion is not internally consistent, so no corrected kinetic constant is silently substituted. This preparation also serves a separate engineered glycoptimus pathway.; Evidence: PMID:31850327, PMID:31850327

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:LACTALDREDUCT-CPLX — has_cofactor → CHEBI:29033; subject experimental construct: 2005 ECL1-derived historical 383-residue FucO in pQE32/pCM1, N-terminal His6, produced in M15(pREP4). Current P0A9S1 is 382 residues.; Evidence PMID:15995211: The FucO crystallographic preparation used ECL1-derived pCM1 in pQE32, N-terminal His6 expression in M15(pREP4) and Ni-NTA purification. a.aria-label: EcoCyc:LACTALDREDUCT-CPLX — has_cofactor → CHEBI:29035; subject experimental construct: Older partially purified oxidoreductase from an E. coli K-12 mutant selected for growth on L-1,2-propanediol; abstract-only preparation information. Ferrous and manganous support are alternatives, not simultaneous obligatory cofactors.; Evidence PMID:4306747: The inspected abstract identifies a partially purified mutant K-12 enzyme and alternative added ferrous or manganous ions. Full experimental details were not acquired. (XPath //PubmedArticle[MedlineCitation/PMID="4306747"]/MedlineCitation/Article/Abstract); The abstract reports that partially purified oxidoreductase from a selected K-12 propanediol-growing mutant requires added ferrous or manganous ions; kinetics vary by metal. This is alternative preparation-specific support, not an obligatory Mn requirement for EG oxidation.; Evidence: PMID:4306747

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:LACTALDREDUCT-CPLX — has_cofactor → CHEBI:57540; NAD coenzyme dependence accompanies the exact Rhea cosubstrate sides. a.aria-label: CHEBI:29105 — inhibits → EcoCyc:LACTALDREDUCT-CPLX; object experimental construct: 2005 ECL1-derived historical 383-residue FucO in pQE32/pCM1, N-terminal His6, produced in M15(pREP4). a.data-node-label: Aerobic respiration control protein ArcA [molecular state: Phosphorylated ArcA reference chain P0A9Q1, the active state explicitly identified as native…]
a.aria-label: Aerobic respiration control protein ArcA; UniProtKB:P0A9Q1; Declared type: protein; molecular state: Phosphorylated ArcA reference chain P0A9Q1, the active state explicitly identified as native PHOSPHO-ARCA. This qualifier preserves the modified regulator; a loss-of-arcA expression experiment alone does not measure its phosphorylation state.; Evidence EcoCyc:PHOSPHO-ARCA: The native phosphorylated regulator has unmodified-form ARCA-MONOMER. Its modified identity is retained as source evidence rather than silently flattened to the reference chain. (XPath /ptools-xml/Protein/unmodified-form | /ptools-xml/Protein/common-name); Evidence EcoCyc:ARCA-MONOMER: This native reference chain has an explicit UniProt unification cross-reference to P0A9Q1. It grounds identity only, not the assay construct or regulatory sign. (XPath /ptools-xml/Protein/dblink[dblink-db="UNIPROT" and dblink-oid="P0A9Q1"])

a.aria-label: Uncharacterized HTH-type transcriptional regulator YgfI; UniProtKB:P52044; Declared type: protein; experimental construct: 2022 BW25113, srsR deletion JW5476, and pCA24N-derived ASKA SrsR overexpression versus empty-vector controls; LB 37 C, 150 rpm, 24 h, 0.5 mM IPTG.
